verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Zero Data Retention policy for Growth tier and above: API-submitted data expires and is automatically deleted within 24 hours. Users can opt into retention with persist_results: true, and Studio-run jobs are exempt from the 24-hour expiry. A ZDR agreement, EU/AU data residency endpoints, and VPC deployments (where all data and storage stay in the customer's VPC) give further control, but these are tied to higher tiers and the docs describe a fixed policy rather than user-managed retention. Missing for 10: an on-demand deletion API or endpoint, configurable retention windows, retention controls on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
